comment: generateRandomId relies on Math.random, which is not cryptographically strong and can collide under load. Treat these as guessable IDs.
codegenInstructions: Replace Math.random with crypto.getRandomValues (Web Crypto) or reuse the dashboard ID helper.

comment: downloadTextFile creates an object URL via URL.createObjectURL and never calls URL.revokeObjectURL after the click. Repeated downloads leak blob URLs.
codegenInstructions: Call URL.revokeObjectURL(el.href) after removeChild, or revoke in a finally block.
